contract: All loaded song roots receive parent-first Begin before their On pass. Native Screen::BeginScreen calls PlayCommand(Begin); ActorFrame::HandleMessage propagates parent-first; Foreground::Update issues On at the foreground start.

native_request.name: native Begin command binding and wrapper return
native_request.lua_assertions:
local order = {}
assert(native_proxy:GetTarget() == nil)
frozen:addcommand('Begin', function(self)
    order[#order+1] = 'Begin'
    self:SetFOV(45)
    native_target:visible(false)
    native_proxy:SetTarget(native_target)
end)
native_proxy:addcommand('On', function(self)
    order[#order+1] = 'On'
    assert(self:GetTarget() == native_target)
end)
frozen:playcommand('Begin')
native_proxy:playcommand('On')
assert(order[1] == 'Begin' and order[2] == 'On')
assert(native_proxy:GetTarget() == native_target)
local wrapper = native_proxy:AddWrapperState()
assert(wrapper == native_proxy:GetWrapperState(1))
native_proxy:AddWrapperState()
assert(native_proxy:GetNumWrapperStates() == 2)

native_control.limits: Actual native actor commands, FOV setter, proxy binding and wrapper return. Begin-before-foreground-On lifecycle and parent-first propagation are established from identical checked source; this control does not construct ScreenGameplay.

regression: Butterfly binds its player proxies and sets its FOV in Begin. Previously DeadSync ran On without a Begin pass.
